name: Forgall Manach

attributes.attribute: the most accomplished woman in Ireland

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Forgall Manach is an Irish hero. He is the parent of beautiful Emer, a woman without equal in Ireland. He tried to curb the courting of the hero Cuchulainn. He packed Cuchulainn off to the fighter Scathach on the Isle of Skye. The scheme failed. It made a hero who later became Ireland's finest fighter.

okr.objective: Forgall Manach is the father of Emer and a rival to Cuchulainn.
key_results: Forgall Manach is the father of Emer.
Emer is the most accomplished woman in Ireland.
He sent Cuchulainn to train with Scathach.
His plan to stop the courtship failed.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore
